leadText: A Mimikyu Bedtime Story (Japanese: おねむりストーリー ミミッキュ A Sleeping Story) is a 1-minute short based on Pokémon Sleep. It was released on the official Pokémon YouTube channels and accounts on October 24, 2024. It was released as a promotion for the Halloween event and accompanied by an in-game event making it easier to encounter and also a distibution of a Mimikyu .
plainText:
A Mimikyu Bedtime Story (Japanese: おねむりストーリー ミミッキュ A Sleeping Story) is a 1-minute short based on Pokémon Sleep. It was released on the official Pokémon YouTube channels and accounts on October 24, 2024. It was released as a promotion for the Halloween event and accompanied by an in-game event making it easier to encounter and also a distibution of a Mimikyu .

==Blurb==
 Spooky dreams don’t have to be scary! 

And just like Mimikyu’s disguise, this sleepy story is nothing to be afraid of. 🤗 

==Plot==
A stumbles upon a clearing where is sleeping. A wearing a Halloween hat is decorating the clearing for Halloween, with s and various gift boxes. While Pikachu fixes the boxes as a spies on it from behind a tree, Mimikyu approaches a Pikachu-shaped Jack-o'-lantern and admires it. Pikachu notices Mimikyu and runs up to it to say hello, but Mimikyu runs away. A chase ensues, ending when both Pikachu and Mimikyu end up in the gift boxes. Mimikyu's gets , and Pikachu helps fix it. Mimikyu now follows Pikachu and the two of them prepare another Jack-o'-lantern with . Afterwards, Pikachu, Mimikyu, and Snorlax eat and Wiki Berries together. Later, a is resting near a sleeping Snorlax, as Pikachu and Mimikyu also start to drowse off. Mimikyu, feeling content, yawns drifts off to sleep. The scene changes to Mimikyu's "Wanna-Curl-Up Sleep" style being recorded in the Sleep Style Dex.
